text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  rustfmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Cache Cargo packages
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Run cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --check

  clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Cache Cargo packages
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Run cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Cache Cargo packages
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Run cargo test
        run: cargo test
```
